name: PP Contract Terms
description: ERPNext contract + project billing policy (not a replacement contract)

fields.label: ERPNext Contract
fields.description: The existing client agreement. Keep the signed agreement here and define its billing policy below.

fields.label: ERPNext Project
fields.description: The client job covered by these terms. Its customer must match the contract.

fields.label: Billing Model
fields.description: Daily: approved worker-days times the client rate. Fixed: approved milestones against the agreed amount. Worker wages stay separate in both models.

fields.label: Currency
fields.description: Use the project company currency. This version does not convert contractor rates between currencies.

fields.label: Agreed Fixed Amount
fields.description: Total agreed client contract value for Fixed billing. Approved milestones cannot exceed this value.

fields.label: Status
fields.description: Use Draft while agreeing terms. Active terms can be used for allocations and preparing client invoices. Closed terms stop new invoicing.
